games.name: A Quiet Place: Deadzone (Pre-Alpha)
games.desc:
The earth has been overrun by deadly extraterrestrial creatures. Using their unimaginably good hearing, these aliens are able to hunt down and silence anyone and anything that makes noise. The United States Government has designated the entirety of the Northeastern United States as a deadzone, where no one has been able to establish contact. In your hometown of Cold Spring, New York, your only hope of survival is to stay silent. 

During this phase, everything that is currently in-game is subject to change. Any gamepasses or products that currently exist are not necessarily permanent. Purchase at your own risk (Expect accomodations of some kind).

Bugs are to be expected. Please report any that you find so we can fix them.

Note: Leaving while in danger (⚠️ indicator in-game) will cause you to lose your saved session.

Use Code: 50KLIKES
New Code at 100K LIKES!
